contentPattern.structure: single quotation + attribution (name + role); decorative quote-mark icon

suitableFor: single highlighted expert / staff testimonial with a name + role attribution
non-rotating pull-quote callouts on a dark band ('What the experts say')
one prominent quotation with a decorative quote-mark icon
notSuitableFor: rotating multi-testimonial sliders with Prev/Next controls (use carousel-quote)
customer review widgets / star ratings (use embed-review)
plain inline blockquotes within body copy (use default content)

usage.notes: Car-insurance 'What the experts say' section (#basic-18930): single white quote card on a dark sea-blue band, quotation attributed to 'Stephen Willmett-Lewis, Senior Motor Product Manager'. Single, non-rotating quotation (distinct from the homepage carousel-quote testimonial slider).
